title: Bag Header Mora Reading & Character Talent Boost Data
summary: Introduces automatic Mora extraction from the Genshin bag header currency bar and establishes game data constellation talent boost mappings (C3/C5) for all characters.

changes.text: Header Mora reading: detects the golden Mora coin in the bag header and reads multi-million integer counts via aspect-preserving area-averaged correlation against game digit templates.
Mora recognition UI: displays the recognized header Mora amount in the Material Recognition panel with live formatting.
Character talent boost mapping: added C3/C5 constellation talent boost definitions (skill or burst) to characters.json for 100% accurate character imports.
Scale & orientation resilience: verified header Mora reading on both desktop and mobile screenshots across multiple aspect ratios (16:9, 19.5:9, 20.5:9) and at half resolution.
